== Notes ==
* Synergizes well with [[attack skill]]s that can cause multiple attacks with a scythe ([[Eremite's Attack]], [[Twin Moon Sweep]], and [[Whirlwind Attack]]) and with [[hex spell]]s that deal damage whenever the hexed foe takes [[physical damage]] ([[Barbs]] and [[Mark of Pain]]).
** When Eremite's Attack or Whirlwind Attack is used, this skill will trigger for each adjacent foe hit.
* Because this triggers ''on attack'', you don't actually have to hit for the damage to occur.
* The damage from Vow of Strength is inflicted before the damage from your scythe. This is relevant for skills such as [[Reversal of Fortune]] or [[Empathy]].
* Because this damages all foes adjacent to the user, [[Kite|kiting]] opponents will avoid damage if they have moved away by the time the attack connects.
* [[Extend Enchantments]] can be used to maintain this enchantment.
